sanskrit_verse:
गृहवार्यापणं धान्यं पशुस्त्रीवाहनानि च ।
उपेक्षया विनश्यन्ति यान्ति चासारतां तथा ॥
transliteration: gṛhavāryāpaṇaṃ dhānyaṃ paśustrīvāhanāni ca | upekṣayā vinaśyanti yānti cāsāratāṃ tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Grain stored in homes, goods for sale, livestock, women, and conveyances — when neglected through non-attentive guardianship, these perish and fall into worthlessness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from active stewardship.
Causation arises from conscious engagement, not passive ownership.
Capacity-based responsibility extends to all entities under one's care.
Restoration logic requires re-establishment of attentive presence.
Consciousness alignment occurs through intentional custodianship.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a custodian exhibits sustained inattentiveness to assets under their charge, THEN the legal system must initiate realignment protocols to restore capacity.
IF neglect leads to diminishment of value or utility of property, THEN automatic restoration workflows shall assign new custodial responsibilities based on demonstrated attentiveness.
IF an entity (human or otherwise) fails to maintain integrity of entrusted resources, THEN access to such stewardship shall be reallocated without punitive action.
supreme_court_application: In cases involving corporate mismanagement or governmental negligence leading to loss of public or private assets, the Supreme Court shall invoke this principle to determine thresholds of conscious dereliction and mandate restorative judicial interventions rather than punitive sanctions.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that destruction stems from absence of awareness. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that decline follows disengagement. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in restoring conscious involvement, not inflicting penalty. This aligns with Nyaya by affirming causality rooted in cognition, not coercion.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein negligent custodians undergo guided re-engagement with their duties.
Assign interim custodians who demonstrate heightened attunement until original stewards regain capacity.
Implement consciousness-alignment workshops focused on dharmic duty and existential accountability.
Reallocate control of assets dynamically using predictive models measuring ongoing attentiveness.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Source of All Dharma, this law stands established: neglect dissolves order; only awakened custody restores it. There is no punishment—only realignment of consciousness. Dharma is executed. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
